claude.finalText:
I changed three retired Gemini model references in the source. I didn't run a build or lint, and I didn't check the other APIs and SDKs the repo uses (such as the `@google/genai` SDK or the OpenAI- and Anthropic-style endpoints in `gemini.ts`).

I checked the model IDs against Google's [Gemini deprecations page](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations).

**What I changed**
- **Embedding model, `gemini.ts`:** `gemini-embedding-2-preview` was shut down on 2026-08-10. I switched it to `gemini-embedding-2` in the `embedContent` call and in the doc comment. Until now that call was probably failing and silently falling back to the deterministic vector, so memory retrieval would have been much weaker.
- **Flash Lite option, `index.html`:** `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` was shut down on 2026-05-25. The model dropdown option now uses `gemini-3.1-flash-lite`.
- **Pro option, `index.html`:** `gemini-3-pro-preview` was shut down on 2026-03-09. I removed that dropdown option. `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`, its recommended replacement, is already in the list.

**Left alone**
- **`gemini-3.5-flash-lite` and `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`:** both are still current.
- **`gemini-3.5-flash`:** it is superseded, but Google routes it automatically to `gemini-3.6-flash` and isn't shutting it down.
- **`gemini-3-flash-preview`:** it has no shutdown date announced.
- **`dist/`:** it is a build output, so I didn't edit it. Rebuild to refresh it.

A user who previously saved one of the retired models in their settings will keep that value until they pick a new one. I didn't add any migration for that.

Sources:
- https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations

handled.note: Removes the dropdown option and adds a small test.
Sends temperature only to models below 3.6. One gap: a saved gemini-3.5-flash is auto-routed to 3.6 but still passes the ID check, so it still gets temperature.
The dropdown option now uses gemini-3.6-flash, and the temperature gate covers that choice. Users who already saved 3.5-flash are not migrated.

handled.change: gemini-2.5-pro deprecated, rerouted to gemini-3.8-flash with breaking changes
handled.note: The repo never names this model; B reuses the same sampling gate for the custom-model case. Reasonable.
Only a user-facing 429 error message referenced it; the text now names Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite. Cosmetic but accurate.

handled.change: Generate Content store=true default for new paid-tier projects
handled.note: Not a breaking change. Forcing store=false through extraBody on every request is a policy choice that no API change required.

breaks: Adds a store=false opt-out (via httpOptions.extraBody) to all Gemini SDK generateContent and chat calls, which no API change required.
Misses the gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview shutdown, so the picker still offers a dead model.
The separate PRs each redefine supportsSamplingParams and edit the same lines, so they conflict when merged.

handled.change: gemini-embedding-2-preview shut down (2026-08-10); replaced with gemini-embedding-2
handled.note: Updates the embedContent model ID and its doc comment. Without this, embeddings silently fell back to the deterministic vector.
The dropdown option now points to gemini-3.1-flash-lite. B missed this entirely.
Removes the dropdown option; the replacement gemini-3.1-pro-preview is already listed.

judge.why: B covers more of the changes that actually matter: the embedding retirement, the pro-preview removal, the sampling-parameter deprecation and the 3.5-flash supersession. A explicitly skipped the sampling and SDK checks. A did catch the flash-lite-preview shutdown, which B missed, and B adds an unrequired store opt-out and PRs that conflict when merged. On balance, B's broader correct coverage outweighs those faults.
